title: Cebu Art Book Fair marks five years of giving everyday stories a place in print

blocks.text: The Cebu Art Book Fair (CABF) unveiled its fifth edition during a press launch on October 29, 2026, at The Kabilin Center in Cebu City, ahead of its November 13 – 15, 2026 fair featuring more than 120 exhibitors from across the Philippines and parts of Asia. Bringing together independent publishers, artists, and storytellers, the event highlights how zines, artist’s books, and other printed works provide opportunities for people to document their experiences, share local perspectives, and contribute to Cebu’s growing creative community.
